name: Victor Negrescu, Niclas Herbst-§ 89-Am 50/2
title: 2025 general budget: all sections
part_text: 89. Reiterates Parliament’s priorities for the forthcoming financial year, namely, focusing Parliament’s budget to deliver on its core functions of co-legislator, acting as one arm of the budgetary authority, representing citizens and scrutinising the work of other institutions, as well as providing the resources for cyber-security and IT development and priority projects on engaging with citizens, green Parliament promoting the saving of resources and an accessible Parliament, fully respecting gender equality
